title: Early Registration Schedule for Pre-K Wraparound Seats
content:
**Schedule.** Under the early-registration schedule of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the combined-program credit for a tuition-based Pre-K child grows when the child's Pre-K Wraparound seat in the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program was registered well before it started. The lead time is counted in calendar days from the seat's registration date to its start date, both as shown on the Creek Kids Club enrollment.

| Seat registered before its start date | Added to the credit |
|---|---|
| at least 14 days before | 10.00 |
| at least 7 but fewer than 14 days before | 5.00 |
| fewer than 7 days before, or on or after the start date | nothing |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical seat starting 15 August)

| Registration date | Days before the start date | Added |
|---|---|---|
| 1 August | 14 | 10.00 |
| 2 August | 13 | 5.00 |
| 8 August | 7 | 5.00 |
| 9 August | 6 | nothing |
